label: GPT-6 Astra
output:
★★★★☆

Used Kilbarrack Van Co for a move from Phibsborough to Drumcondra on 17 October. Overall, the lads were great and I’d use them again, but there were a couple of things that make it four stars rather than five.

For anyone comparing prices, I was quoted €340 for two lads and the van for up to four hours. It was a two-bed flat, though mostly my own stuff being moved, and the new place is a fourth-floor walk-up with no lift. The whole thing took about three and a half hours. Other quotes I’d had were €450 upwards, so they were the best value I found. Booked through the website and paid a €50 deposit by Revolut.

The main issue on the day was timing. They were booked for 9am and arrived at 10.30. I did get a text at 8.40 saying the previous job had run over, so I wasn’t left wondering whether they were coming, but it was still a fair bit of sitting around on boxes with a cold coffee. It wasn’t the end of the world for my move, but if you’ve a tight handover time with a landlord, it’s worth making that clear when booking. Dessie knocked €40 off afterwards for the delay without me asking, which I thought was fair and appreciated.

Once they got there, they got through a lot of work, especially considering all the stairs. The couch wouldn’t make it around the turn on the third floor and I was wondering how that was going to work. One of the lads had an Allen key in his pocket, took the legs off and got it straight in. They also put the bed back together without being asked and took away a flat-pack shelf I didn’t want. Those bits made a real difference when there was already enough to be doing.

The other downside was that the base of my brass floor lamp got chipped. Everything else was wrapped in blankets, but the lamp wasn’t. It was my nanny’s, so I was a bit gutted about that. I know moving furniture up four flights isn’t easy, but I’d have liked the same care taken with that as with the rest of the stuff. Wrap the lamps, lads!

On balance, I’d recommend them for the value and the work they put in. There was plenty they did well, and the unprompted discount for being late was a decent way to handle it. I’d book them again, but I’d flag anything sentimental for extra wrapping and leave a bit of breathing room on timing. Four stars feels fair for my experience.
